visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with black hair and a light beige t-shirt, gesturing excitedly in front of a grey and white floral patterned wallpaper. She smiles broadly, her mouth open as if speaking energetically, while rings sparkle on her fingers and large text overlays appear briefly. (2) The scene shifts to a tight close-up of a slender, metallic gold lipstick tube held against the floral background, showcasing its reflective surface. Text detailing the brand and shade numbers appears at the top. (3) A hand enters the frame, using a small metal cosmetic spatula to apply two distinct shades of reddish-pink lipstick onto the back of another hand. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the creamy texture of the product. (4) A close-up displays two swatches on the skin, labeled with white text overlays 'NARS' and 'KATE'. The camera remains steady as the person points to the differences in tone between the two. (5) The woman holds a pink heart-shaped mirror and applies lipstick to her lips. The screen is split visually with labels and arrows indicating different brands being tested on each side of her mouth. She examines her reflection closely, articulating her thoughts with varied facial expressions. (6) Upon revealing a result, a large yellow 'O' symbol appears over the woman as she celebrates with high energy, throwing her head back and pumping her fists. The background remains the same floral wall and white sofa. (7) The video concludes with the woman gesturing towards the camera, a '平替失敗！' graphic appearing as she provides a final evaluation of the product comparison.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly with a bright, professional tone, set against a mid-tempo electronic BGM featuring a steady synth bassline and light percussion. A distinct 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs within the first second, marking the narrator's shift into an enunciated product description with varied pitch contours. (2) A sharp, high-frequency 'ding' sound effect triggers this phase, indicating a successful identification or correct answer. The narrator's voice immediately spikes in pitch and volume, exhibiting high arousal and excitement as she begins a loud celebratory vocalization. The BGM continues with its rhythmic drive, remaining subordinate to the loud vocal signal. (3) A synthetic applause and cheering sound effect layer enters the mix, accompanying the narrator's high-intensity shouting and laughter. The vocal quality shows noticeable strain and breathiness as the speaker celebrates, while the electronic BGM maintains a consistent tempo of approximately 124 BPM, providing a festive and energetic acoustic atmosphere. (4) The final phase is marked by a sudden, dull percussive impact sound effect that punctuates the end of the narrator's concluding sentence. The vocal delivery returns to a moderate conversational loudness and a friendly tone, with the BGM slowly fading out to silence, leaving a clean room tone in the final moments of the recording.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Blind Trial -> Reveal -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a detailed comparison between a high-end luxury lipstick (NARS) and a budget-friendly drugstore alternative (KATE). Through a blind application test and color swatching, the creator evaluates if the cheaper option can serve as a viable substitute, concluding with a personal verdict that the 'dupe' failed to perfectly match the original.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal and visual comparison of specific lipstick brands (NARS and KATE) with model numbers shown on screen.
